entries.mitigation: Move the player-targeted storm into the large roaming storm to disperse it before the group-wide damage becomes unmanageable.
Watch the marked player and dodge the larva detonation instead of letting multiple explosions land in the stack.
In Hard Mode, balance platform time with brief water resets. Static builds while out of the water, but the water itself hurts, so rotate deliberately rather than panicking between platforms.
Tank stays ready for Sarydil's teleport heavy and keeps her controlled instead of ranging so far away that the follow-up catches the group unprepared.
Marked player walks trap drops around the outside edge and preserves the middle for later safe movement.
Interrupt the shadowy assassins focusing the marked target. Leaving the channels running turns the mechanic into sustained lethal focus fire.
Find the safe gap before the arena traps detonate. Do not solve the mechanic by adding more badly placed traps to the route everyone needs.
Track wave origins and move between crossing paths. Hard Mode can overlap waves from multiple sides, so keep the group mobile instead of anchoring in one quadrant.
Tank and focus gryphons promptly. Iliata's lightning fields and Mafremare's tornadoes become far worse when allowed to overlap with boss mechanics.
Tethered partners stay close and move as a pair while the healer supports the damage-over-time pressure.
Heal through the DoT while keeping attention on waves and add positioning; it is dangerous mainly because it overlaps movement mechanics.
Dodge inward or sideways as the fear waves travel outward. Avoid rolling outward into the path of the next wave.
Chain or focus the Flame Shapers and interrupt Inferno immediately so group damage does not stack with the rest of the arena pressure.
Kill Haunters quickly because their tether debuffs damage, healing, and armor on the affected player.
In Hard Mode, resolve each bomb with exactly two players. Too few or too many players in the share is lethal; preassigned partners simplify the first cycles.
Kill two wolves directly opposite one another, then move into the safe areas left where they died before the room-wide resolution.
Tank moves Nazaray out of blue circles immediately. Standing in them makes her immune and dramatically increases incoming tank damage.
Control or kill lurchers when pressure is high, but avoid forcing a bad overlap with a Kindred Spirit cycle. High-damage groups may manage rather than hard-focus them.
Tank blocks only with sufficient mitigation or dodge-rolls the heavy, especially while Nazaray is empowered.
Tank dodge-rolls the cast to avoid being lifted and losing aggro during a chaotic movement window.
Interrupt Retch when practical and control corpse pressure without abandoning the boss. Their ranged attacks and channels create the bile that consumes arena space.
Read the adjacent wave origins early and move through clean lanes. Waves also wash away bile, so use the reset instead of fighting the arena forever.
Place and move cleanly so bile does not choke the small platform before later Hulk and wave overlaps.
